children.name: Contract: Validate CreateQuoteResponse payload against JSON Schema
Happy Path: Create quote with multiple items and mixed discounts
AC2: Successfully create quote with single item with discount
AC1: Successfully create a new quote with one item for a customer
Negative: Attempt to create a quote without customer name
AC3: Successfully create a new quote with two items for a customer
HealthCheck: Verify service availability and endpoint status 200
Negative: Attempt to create a quote without items
